entries.reason: the release's Bonjour has no peer-to-peer interface: it publishes and resolves over the networks the device is on
entries.effect: the value is kept and read back, and services are found on those networks as before
entries.source: the host's own UIKit/Foundation under Mac Catalyst through tests/backports/host/smallapis2, and tests/backports/device/smallapis2.m on iOS 6
